name: esp32_blink_strip
description: blink with the LED strip on the ESP32: the RMT (channel 0, 10 MHz from APB_CLK, through the matrix's rmt_sig_out0) sends the WS2812B white at 16/255 for one second, then black, and again; the console says each. Five frames by 3.8 s: the clear when the strip is configured, then OFF, ON, OFF, ON.

expect.contains: Example configured to blink addressable LED!
